entries: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first

Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt

Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them
Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window
Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each
Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts
Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

title.zh-TW: Slack 跨頻道畫布可接續編輯，參與方式設定更名
title.en: Slack Cross-Channel Canvases Allow Continued Edits, Participation Setting Renamed

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 跨組織討論或跨頻道共用畫布時，你可能遇過回覆沒人接、Claude 拒絕編輯的狀況。以前 Claude 在頻道自己建立的 Canvas 畫布，另分享至其他頻道或私訊後，就會拒絕在原頻道編輯或追加內容；現在已恢復支援。在兩家公司皆啟用 Claude 的 Slack Connect 討論串中，未特別標註的回覆也不再因轉發至另一家公司的應用程式而漏接。雲端排程的即時清單現在能直接更新當次發出的頂層訊息，避免進度卡在未完成狀態。頻道 Configure 設定頁與 Claude Tag 管理設定中的自動回應開關，都改為「Claude 參與方式」選單。
body.en: When collaborating across organizations or sharing canvases across channels in Slack, you may have encountered unanswered replies or Claude refusing to edit. Previously, once a canvas Claude created in a channel was shared to another channel or a direct message, it refused to edit or append content from that channel; this support has now been restored. In Slack Connect threads where both organizations have enabled Claude, untagged replies no longer go unanswered when forwarded to the other organization's app. The live checklist for cloud scheduled tasks can now directly update top-level messages posted during that run, preventing progress from staying half-done. On a channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings, the Respond automatically switch has been changed to a "How Claude participates" menu.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段支援 MCP 表單填寫，密鑰管理與路徑顯示最佳化
title.en: Cloud Sessions Support MCP Form Completion, Secret Management and Path Display Refined

body.zh-TW: 當你透過瀏覽器切換雲端工作階段處理專案，各種互動提示與環境權限有了明確回饋。現在當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器提出表單請求，介面會跳出卡片讓你填寫或拒絕，不再無預警直接取消。切回雲端或 Remote Control 遠端控制工作階段時，若訊息還在同步更新，畫面會顯示「Catching up…」。企業版成員能在個人雲端環境新增或刪除網路密鑰，不再限制只能檢視。雲端工作階段的 Files 檔案面板搜尋，修好了 Claude 切換目錄後把資料夾顯示成 ../.. 路徑的問題，改為顯示自專案根目錄起算的路徑。變更面板的省略說明也收納成分支名稱旁的徽章。
body.en: When switching between cloud sessions in a browser to work on projects, interactive prompts and environment permissions now offer clearer feedback. Now, when an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server requests a form, a card pops up in the interface for you to fill in or decline instead of the request being canceled without warning. When switching back to a cloud or Remote Control session while messages are still updating, the screen displays "Catching up…". Enterprise members can now add and delete network secrets in their personal cloud environments, rather than being restricted to view-only access. In a cloud session's Files pane search, a bug where folders appeared as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory has been fixed, and paths now show from the project root. The note explaining what the Changes pane leaves out has also been moved into a badge beside the branch name.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root

title.zh-TW: VSCode 面板支援閘道登入，思考彩虹特效與介面控制項修復
title.en: VSCode Panel Supports Gateway Sign-In, Thinking Rainbow Effect and UI Controls Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 側邊欄與 Claude 協同撰寫程式碼時，登入內部服務與微調思考強度有了更完整的介面支援。現在聊天面板可直接登入企業的 Claude apps 閘道器，無須另外開啟終端機。在對話輸入 `ultrathink`，會讓當回合採用 `xhigh` 極高思考力度，並在聊天輸入框呈現彩虹效果。模型設定帶有 `[1m]` 標記時，Effort 思考力度滑桿、Ultracode 開關與模型名稱也都恢復顯示。設定檔出錯時，已儲存的 `/btw` 提問紀錄不會再被意外清除。若先前已指定手動審核修改，重新載入編輯器後也不會誤跳回自動模式。
body.en: When collaborating on code with Claude in the VSCode sidebar, signing in to internal services and fine-tuning thinking effort now have more complete interface support. The chat panel can now sign in directly to an enterprise Claude apps gateway without opening a separate terminal. Entering `ultrathink` in a conversation runs that turn at `xhigh` effort and displays a rainbow effect in the chat box. When model settings carry the `[1m]` tag, the Effort slider, Ultracode switch, and model name are restored. When a configuration file contains errors, saved `/btw` question history will no longer be wiped accidentally. If manual approval of edits was previously specified, reloading the editor will no longer mistakenly revert to Auto mode.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查改採結構化卡片，分析頁新增嚴重度統計圖表
title.en: Code Review Adopts Structured Cards, Analytics Page Adds Severity Charts

body.zh-TW: 當你提交程式碼請 Claude 協助把關專案品質，產出的審查摘要與分析統計現在一目了然。從桌面版或網頁的 Code 分頁發起 `/code-review` 時，雲端與 `claude remote-control` 遠端控制工作階段會直接顯示結構化的審查結果卡片，取代純文字清單。分析頁面的嚴重程度卡片會顯示所選期間的問題總數、每日依嚴重程度堆疊的圖表，以及各級數量。執行 `/ultrareview`、雲端工作階段或雲端代理找不到 GitHub 遠端關聯時，訊息會指引你到 https://github.com/new 建立儲存庫；其中 `/ultrareview` 也不再推薦會被 `gh` 拒絕的指令。
body.en: When submitting code for Claude to review project quality, the resulting review summaries and analytical statistics are now immediately clear. Starting `/code-review` from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web now displays a structured findings card in cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions instead of a plain-text list. The findings-by-severity card on the analytics page shows the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and counts for each severity level. When `/ultrareview`, a cloud session, or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote, the message guides you to create a repository at https://github.com/new; in addition, `/ultrareview` no longer recommends a command that `gh` rejects.

items.original:
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

title.zh-TW: Bash 工具完整保留別名與函式，背景命令退出不再殘留
title.en: Bash Tool Retains Aliases and Functions, Background Commands No Longer Linger on Exit

body.zh-TW: 當你透過終端機交由 Claude 執行腳本，自訂 Shell（執行指令的環境）的相容性有了修正。macOS 或 Linux 上，Claude Code 因憑證遭拒或雲端工作階段歸檔而自行退出時，不再留下仍執行中的命令。Bash 工具不再弄亂或遺失含換行的別名，但不含 Git Bash；減號開頭的函式名稱也已修好。匯出 `SHELLOPTS` 的腳本不再執行第一句就停擺。Windows 的 Git Bash 若在 rc 啟動設定檔同時設定 errexit 與 pipefail，且只定義 winpty 別名或沒有別名，也不再遺失別名與函式。PowerShell 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）的指令以型別轉換、`param`、`using` 或屬性開頭時，也能依結束代碼 2 阻擋執行。
body.en: When having Claude run scripts through the terminal, compatibility with a custom shell (an environment for running commands) has been improved. On macOS or Linux, when Claude Code exits on its own because credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived, it no longer leaves running commands behind. The Bash tool no longer garbles or loses aliases containing line breaks—except in Git Bash—and functions whose names start with a dash are now fixed. Scripts that export `SHELLOPTS` no longer stall right after their first command. In Windows Git Bash, when an rc startup file sets both errexit and pipefail while defining only winpty aliases or none at all, aliases and functions are no longer lost. When commands in PowerShell hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) start with a type cast, `param`, `using`, or an attribute, they also properly block execution on exit code 2.

items.original:
Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined

title.zh-TW: 自動模式權限規則防意外覆寫，中斷狀態與伺服器判定修復
title.en: Auto Mode Permission Rules Prevent Accidental Overwrites, Interruption Status and Server Verdicts Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在自動模式下讓 Claude 連續執行任務時，權限清單與中斷原因不該讓你摸不著頭緒。受管理的 `autoMode.allow` 允許清單未含 `"$defaults"` 時，不再因主應用程式的 `--settings`、首次在 `/permissions` 加規則或 `/auto-mode-setup`，而加回內建例外；排程任務提示的內建規則也不會因此被移除。雲端工作階段與排程任務若因伺服器未回傳安全判定、由自動模式停止該回合，會確實標記失敗。背景代理仍在執行時，`claude -p` 文字輸出也會交代自動模式停止回合的原因。由主應用程式啟動、經代理伺服器或 LLM 大型語言模型閘道器連線且關閉實驗性測試功能時，環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` 不再被忽略。
body.en: When having Claude run tasks continuously in auto mode, permission lists and reasons for interruptions should never leave you guessing. When a managed `autoMode.allow` list omits "$defaults", built-in exceptions are no longer reintroduced by a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`; nor is the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts removed because of this. Cloud sessions and scheduled tasks are now properly marked as failed when auto mode stops a turn because the server returned no safety verdict. While a background agent is still running, `claude -p` text output also explains why auto mode stopped a turn. In sessions started by a host application through a proxy or an LLM (large language model) gateway with experimental features turned off, the `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` environment variable is no longer ignored.

items.original:
Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts

title.zh-TW: 憑證錯誤提示列出具體解法，保留私有 CA 所需的交叉憑證
title.en: Certificate Errors Detail Actionable Fixes, Retaining Cross-Certificates for Private CAs

body.zh-TW: 當工具在企業內網或受管網路發送請求，遇到連線驗證失敗時不再只丟出一行模糊代碼。⟦跟海關查驗護照上的簽證戳章一樣，如果發現缺少中介審核章，系統會直接指出漏蓋了哪一關，而不是冷冷關閉閘門。⟧現在遇到 SSL 憑證錯誤，終端機會直接分析可能原因，例如伺服器遺漏了中介憑證，並附上具體的修正指引。針對需要內部私有憑證的架構，可啟用環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP`，保留系統中循環互簽的交叉憑證。另外，當伺服器回傳的壓縮資料中途截斷或損毀時，網路請求也不會再無限期卡死。
body.en: When tools send requests across an enterprise intranet or managed network, connection verification failures no longer throw a vague line of code. ⟦Just like customs inspecting visa stamps in a passport, if an intermediate verification stamp is missing, the system points out exactly which checkpoint was skipped instead of coldly shutting the gate.⟧ Now when an SSL certificate error occurs, the terminal directly analyzes likely causes, such as a server omitting an intermediate certificate, and provides specific remediation instructions. For architectures requiring internal private certificates, you can enable the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` environment variable to retain cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop. In addition, network requests will no longer hang indefinitely if compressed data returned by a server is cut off or corrupted midway.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each

title.zh-TW: 閘道器支援群組共用預算，階層政策與 Bedrock 防護標籤上線
title.en: Gateway Supports Pooled Group Budgets, Layered Policies and Bedrock Guardrail Tagging Released

body.zh-TW: 管理團隊花費與權限時，Claude apps 閘道器有了新選項。花費限制管理 API 的 `pooled_budget` 可設群組每月共用預算，各人仍有個別上限。`managed.policy_mode: layered` 套用所有相符政策，上方覆蓋下方。Bedrock 上游的 `guardrail.input_tagging` 加上提示詞攻擊篩選標籤；`all_messages_and_system` 也替系統提示詞加標籤。請求內每個模型都會檢查 `availableModels`、`deniedModels`、`models`；被封鎖時回傳 400 錯誤並指出對應欄位。強制使用閘道器時，終端機的 `claude auth login` 會顯示其登入入口。Team／Enterprise 從 Anthropic API 取得的受管理設定免確認套用；儲存副本驗證失敗就拒用。
body.en: When managing team spend and permissions, the Claude apps gateway has new options. The `pooled_budget` field on the spend limits admin API can set a monthly shared budget for a group on top of each member's individual limit. Setting `managed.policy_mode: layered` applies all matching policies, merging each over the ones listed below it. On Bedrock upstreams, `guardrail.input_tagging` adds prompt attack filter tags; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt. Every model named in a request is checked against `availableModels`, `deniedModels`, and `models`; if blocked, a 400 error is returned naming the relevant field. When a gateway is required, running `claude auth login` in a terminal shows the gateway sign-in prompt. Managed settings fetched from the Anthropic API for Team and Enterprise accounts apply without confirmation, and any stored copy that fails verification is rejected.

items.original:
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused

title.zh-TW: Opus 4.8 快速模式排定退場，三個模型別名修復自動備援
title.en: Opus 4.8 Fast Mode Slated for Deprecation, Three Model Aliases Restore Fallback

body.zh-TW: 當你在多個雲端平台切換不同版本的 Claude 模型，版本遷移與容錯機制有了具體指引。Opus 4.8 快速模式自 2026 年 10 月 30 日起棄用，將於 11 月 30 日移除；移除後的快速模式請求會報錯，不會回退標準版，需遷移至 Opus 5.5 才能保有加速。在 Vertex AI 與 Amazon Bedrock 上，`sonnet`、`opus`、`haiku` 這三個模型別名，若最新版尚未向帳號或區域開放，會切換至相容舊版提供備援，不再於工作階段中途報錯。若用 `/model <id>` 輸入此版本未辨識的型號，也會主動跳出警告，提醒自動壓縮將預設採用 200K 的上下文視窗容量，也就是可容納的對話量。
body.en: When switching between different Claude model versions across multiple cloud platforms, version migration and fault tolerance now have clear guidance. Fast mode for Opus 4.8 has been deprecated as of October 30, 2026, and will be removed on November 30, 2026; once removed, fast mode requests will return an error rather than falling back to standard Opus 4.8, requiring migration to Opus 5.5 to maintain speedups. On Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock, the `sonnet`, `opus`, and `haiku` model aliases now switch to a compatible older version to provide fallback if the newest release is not yet available to your account or region, rather than failing mid-session. Entering an unrecognized model with `/model <id>` now triggers a warning that auto-compact will assume a 200K context window (the conversation volume it can hold).

items.original:
Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window

title.zh-TW: 子代理可設定預設運算力度，支援關閉深度思考關鍵字
title.en: Subagents Support Default Effort Settings, Deep Thinking Keyword Can Be Disabled

body.zh-TW: 當你指派背景子代理分頭調查程式庫，任務的思考深度與模型繼承現在能精細掌控。如果團隊不想觸發額外的高強度推論，可透過環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` 直接停用 `ultrathink` 關鍵字。針對後台衍生出的子代理（處理專案分支任務的助手），只有在其他來源都未指定運算力度時，才會使用 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT`，取代預設繼承主工作階段力度的行為。繼承了上層子代理專屬模型的助手，在被背景通知或新訊息喚醒後，也能持續鎖定指定模型，不會意外跳回主對話模型。
body.en: When dispatching background subagents (helpers that handle branching project tasks) to investigate a codebase, thinking depth and model inheritance can now be finely controlled. If a team prefers not to trigger extra high-intensity reasoning, the `ultrathink` keyword can be disabled directly via the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` environment variable. For subagents spawned in the background, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` is used only when no other source specifies an effort level, replacing the default behavior of inheriting the main session's effort. Helpers that inherit a parent subagent's dedicated model will also stay locked to that assigned model after being awakened by a background notification or new message, rather than unexpectedly reverting to the main conversation model.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器與外掛環境修復，改善 SDK 與產物規則載入
title.en: Fixes for self-hosted runners and plugin environments, with improved SDK and Artifact rule loading

body.zh-TW: 自行架設執行環境或撰寫外掛整合時，跨機器狀態與規則顯示不再莫名出錯。自架執行器的工作階段換機後，MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器開關狀態不再遺失；按下停止並替換程序後，也不再答覆工作中傳入的舊訊息。外掛的憑證環境變數設為 `1` 等開關值時，`headersHelper` 腳本收到的 `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` 與伺服器網址不再損毀。SDK（軟體開發工具包）的 `register_repo_root` 請求，在 `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1` 下能載入工作目錄外的 `CLAUDE.md`。產物工具不再把 `self` 自身層級的資料庫存取規則顯示為問號；拒絕會移除這些規則的重新發布時，也會引用這些規則。
body.en: When hosting your own execution environments or writing plugin integrations, cross-machine state and rule displays no longer encounter unexplained errors. After a self-hosted runner session moves to a new machine, the on/off switch state of an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server is no longer lost. After pressing Stop and replacing the process, it also no longer answers old messages sent while Claude was working. When a plugin credential environment variable is set to a switch value such as `1`, the `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL received by `headersHelper` scripts are no longer corrupted. With `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`, the SDK (software development kit) `register_repo_root` request can now load `CLAUDE.md` from outside the working directory. The Artifact tool no longer displays artifact database access rules at the `self` level as question marks, and now quotes those rules back when refusing a republish that would drop them.

items.original:
Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine

title.zh-TW: 提示詞輸入清理不可見字元，介面提示與問卷送出機制修正
title.en: Invisible character cleaning in prompt input, with fixes for interface hints and survey submissions

body.zh-TW: 日常在命令列輸入提問與檢視提示時，多處影響打字節奏的介面細節得到了改善。以前從網頁複製文字若夾帶不可見字元，常需連按兩次 Enter 才能送出；現在普通提問第一次按下就會清除這些字元並發送，指令仍保留審查確認步驟。語音輸入提示不再於單一工作階段內耗盡三次顯示額度，未綁定按住說話的熱鍵時，也不再出現空白鍵帽。在窄視窗終端機初次啟動時，安全說明與終端機設定說明都不再漏字。若對話尚在儲存時執行過 `/clear` 清除或 `/resume` 接續指令，還原對話時也能恢復原本的任務計畫。企業問卷輸入 `1` 或 `0` 後，不再因短暫停頓就送出，必須按 Enter 才會確認。
body.en: When entering prompts and viewing hints in daily command-line use, multiple interface details that affect typing rhythm have been improved. Previously, copying text from web pages that contained invisible characters often required pressing Enter twice to send. Plain prompts now clean these characters and send on the first Enter press, while commands still retain the review confirmation step. The voice input hint no longer uses up its quota of three showings in a single session, and an empty keycap no longer appears when push-to-talk is unbound. During first-run startup in narrow terminal windows, security notes and terminal setup explanations no longer drop words. If `/clear` or `/resume` was run while a conversation was still being saved, resuming the conversation now also restores the original task plan. After typing `1` or `0` in the Enterprise survey, answers are no longer submitted due to a short pause, and now require pressing Enter to confirm.

items.original:
Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter

title.zh-TW: 受限工作階段不再上傳目錄外檔案，比對與搜尋效能改善
title.en: Restricted sessions no longer upload files outside directories, with diff and search performance improvements

body.zh-TW: 當你在大型專案中比對程式碼變更或搜尋檔案，檔案上傳範圍與回應速度更為可靠。⟦恰似廠區門禁嚴格核對出入清單，即使持有特殊通行證，非指定作業區的機密文件一律禁止攜出大門。⟧以往在 `--restricted` 受限工作階段中，即使工作目錄外的檔案有 Read 讀取允許規則涵蓋，仍不該被上傳；現在已修好這項上傳限制。在大型儲存庫輸入 `/diff` 查看差異時，每次重新整理通常少執行一個掃描整個儲存庫的 Git 命令，並在 Git 反應變慢時自動拉開重新整理間隔。針對 Windows 使用者，Grep 與 Glob 搜尋工具在觸發逾時停止時，也不會再因搜尋行程未順利結束而無止境卡住畫面。
body.en: When comparing code changes or searching files across large projects, file upload scope and responsiveness are now more reliable. ⟦A factory security checkpoint strictly checks the entry and exit list: even with a special pass, confidential documents outside designated work areas are strictly barred from being carried out the gate.⟧ Previously in `--restricted` sessions, files outside working directories were not supposed to be uploaded even when covered by a Read allow rule. This upload restriction has now been fixed. When entering `/diff` in large repositories to inspect changes, each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository Git command, and refresh intervals are automatically spaced out when Git responds slowly. For Windows users, Grep and Glob search tools no longer freeze the screen indefinitely when a search process is killed at timeout but fails to exit cleanly.

items.original:
Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

title.zh-TW: 內建 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者，支援 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
title.en: Built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI Provider and Support for GPT-6.1 Terra

body.zh-TW:
如果你習慣使用 Google Cloud 部署各項服務，現在可以直接透過 Vertex AI 調用模型，不用再自己撰寫複雜的轉接外掛。

設定檔只要加入：

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

就能直接切換為內建的 Google Cloud Vertex AI 提供者。同時，官方模型清單也加入了最新推出的 GPT-6.1 Terra，讓你在挑選模型時有更多元的運算選擇。

⟦宛如到連鎖租車行租賃商務車隊，以前想開特定廠牌還得自己找外包車行簽約，現在官方直接納入特約合作名單，還同步上架了最新款旗艦房車供你自由挑選。⟧

當你著手建置企業內部應用，想把 AI 運算統一收整在既有的 Google Cloud 專案與帳單下，只要在設定檔指定 `gcp`，就能立刻連接 Vertex AI 資源；需要測試最新模型能力時，也能直接在清單中選用 GPT-6.1 Terra。
body.en:
If you are used to deploying services on Google Cloud, you can now call models directly through Vertex AI without writing complex adapter plugins yourself.

Simply add the following to your configuration file:

```toml
model_provider = "gcp"
```

This directly switches to the built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider. At the same time, the official model catalog now includes the newly released GPT-6.1 Terra, giving you more computing options when choosing models.

⟦Picture renting a commercial fleet from a car rental chain. In the past, driving a specific brand required finding and contracting with outside agencies on your own. Now the company directly adds them to its partner roster and puts the latest flagship sedan in the lineup for you to choose from.⟧

When building internal enterprise applications and consolidating AI compute under existing Google Cloud projects and billing, you only need to specify `gcp` in the configuration file to connect to Vertex AI resources immediately. When you need to test the latest model capabilities, you can also select GPT-6.1 Terra directly from the catalog.

items.original:
Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265)
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段選擇器支援儲存庫篩選，指令中心依目錄分組
title.en: Session Picker Supports Repository Filtering, Agent Command Center Groups by Directory

body.zh-TW:
當你同時在多個專案副本間切換工作時，要在落落長的工作階段清單裡找出剛剛開啟的對話往往得費一番工夫。

在搭配 Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）進行多工處理時，工作階段選擇器現在加入了儲存庫篩選機制，你可以快速過濾出屬於特定專案的工作階段。

⟦好比大型檔案庫整頓借閱卡，以前所有專案的借閱單全塞在同一個抽屜，找紀錄得一張張比對；現在能按專案名稱抽取專屬卡盒，櫃台還會按實體檔案夾分層收納。⟧

代理指令中心也同步支援目錄分組，會將關聯在同一工作樹目錄下的所有紀錄整合在一起，讓跨副本的工作階段瀏覽井然有序。當你一邊在主專案修復問題，另一邊在副本測試新功能時，只要開啟選擇器輸入專案名稱，就能切回目標對話，不再被其他專案的工作階段干擾。
body.en:
When juggling work across multiple project copies, locating a recently opened conversation in a long session list often takes considerable effort.

When multitasking with Git worktrees (a feature allowing multiple copies of the same project in parallel), the session picker now includes a repository filter, allowing you to quickly filter out sessions belonging to a specific project.

⟦Imagine a large archive reorganizing its checkout slips. Previously, slips from all projects were stuffed into a single drawer, forcing you to check records one by one. Now you can pull out a dedicated card box by project name, and the desk organizes them into tiers by physical folder.⟧

The agent command center now also supports directory grouping, bringing together all records associated with the same worktree directory to keep session navigation across copies neat and orderly. When you are fixing an issue in the main project while testing a new feature in a copy, you can simply open the picker and type the project name to switch back to the target conversation without distraction from other projects' sessions.

items.original: Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器 API 支援附加對話分支，實驗性拆分子討論串
title.en: App-Server API Supports Experimental Attached Thread Forks

body.zh-TW:
如果你正在透過應用伺服器介面開發專屬工具，想在同一個對話脈絡下嘗試不同解法時，管理獨立分支往往相當繁瑣。

`app-server` 的 API 現在加入了實驗性的附加對話分支（從既有對話衍生出附屬子討論串的機制）。這項功能讓應用程式能直接從既有對話拆出分支，既完整保留主線累積的上下文，又不會讓測試過程弄亂原本的紀錄。

⟦恰似在活頁筆記本貼上延伸標籤頁，以前想嘗試第二種草案只能整本重新謄寫，現在直接在關鍵頁面夾入附屬便箋，既保留原有筆記的脈絡，寫壞了也能隨時抽換。⟧

當你需要讓使用者對同一個問題評估多種修改方案時，就能透過這組介面拉出附屬討論串進行推演，讓主線對話隨時維持乾淨。
body.en:
If you are developing custom tools through the app-server interface and want to try different solutions within the same conversational context, managing separate branches can often be cumbersome.

The `app-server` API now includes experimental attached thread forks (a mechanism for branching secondary sub-threads from an existing conversation). This feature allows applications to branch directly off an existing conversation, preserving the full context accumulated in the main thread while preventing experiments from cluttering original records.

⟦Think of attaching extension tabs to a loose-leaf notebook. Previously, trying a second draft meant rewriting the entire notebook from scratch. Now you insert an attached memo directly into key pages, preserving the original context while letting you swap out bad drafts at any time.⟧

When you need users to evaluate multiple revision options for the same issue, you can use this interface to spin off secondary threads for exploration while keeping the primary conversation completely clean.

items.original: Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)

title.zh-TW: 支援對話途中調整思考力度，預設開放動態切換
title.en: Support for Adjusting Reasoning Effort Mid-Conversation, Enabled by Default

body.zh-TW:
向 AI 提問時如果一開始只隨口聊聊，隨後卻突然碰上需要抽絲剝繭的複雜架構，往往會受限於最初設定的思考程度。

針對有支援的模型，現在已經預設允許在對話途中直接修改思考力度（決定模型在回答前投入多少推理運算的參數）。你不再需要為了讓 AI 想得更深入而特地中斷對話另開新局，交談到一半隨時能依照問題難度靈活增減思考量。

⟦跟下西洋棋時切換思考時限一樣，以前開局選了快棋就只能一路快打到底，現在遇到膠著局面能當場多要幾分鐘長考，解開難題後又能切回節奏，不必把整盤棋推倒重來。⟧

當你原本只是請它解讀一段日常日誌，中途突然想探討分散式鎖的死結原因時，就能當場調高力度，讓模型針對核心邏輯進行深度推理。
body.en:
When asking an AI questions, starting with casual chat and then suddenly running into a complex architecture that demands deep dissection often leaves you constrained by your initial thinking depth.

For supported models, changing reasoning effort (the parameter determining how much reasoning computation the model invests before answering) during a conversation is now enabled by default. You no longer need to interrupt the conversation and start a new session just to make the AI think more deeply; you can flexibly adjust the amount of thinking midway based on question complexity.

⟦A chess clock adjustment reflects this transition. Previously, choosing blitz at the opening meant rushing through the entire match. Now, when a stalemate strikes, you can claim a few extra minutes on the spot to think deeply, then switch back to your normal pace once the puzzle is solved without resetting the board.⟧

When you initially ask it to interpret a routine log and suddenly decide to explore the root cause of a distributed lock deadlock midway through, you can increase the effort on the spot to let the model perform deep reasoning on the core logic.

items.original: Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)

title.zh-TW: 新設定檔預設啟用第二代記憶，支援匯入外部代理記憶
title.en: Fresh Profiles Enable Memory v2 by Default with Support for Importing External-Agent Memories

body.zh-TW:
每次建立新的個人設定檔時，如果希望 AI 能記住你的偏好或從其他工具轉移習慣，往往需要不少手動設定。

現在建立全新設定檔時，工具會預設啟用第二代記憶架構（讓工具跨對話保存使用者偏好的機制）。這套架構也同步支援匯入外部代理的記憶資料，能直接讀取其他 AI 工具先前累積的偏好與操作紀錄。

⟦如同搬進全新裝潢的智慧住宅，以前每次換新家都要重新訓練管家認識你的生活作息，現在進門就有現成的智慧管家隨時待命，還能直接把前任管家的備忘手冊整本讀取完畢。⟧

當你從其他開發助理切換到 Codex 時，不用再從頭教它你的排版風格與常用語法，只要把既有的記憶檔匯入，新設定檔就能立刻依循你的慣用模式工作。
body.en:
Whenever you create a new profile, having the AI remember your preferences or transfer habits from other tools usually requires considerable manual setup.

When creating fresh profiles, the tool now enables memory v2 (a mechanism allowing the tool to preserve user preferences across conversations) by default. This architecture also supports importing external-agent memories, directly reading preferences and operational logs accumulated in other AI tools.

⟦Consider moving into a newly renovated smart home. Previously, each move meant retraining a butler to learn your daily routine. Now, a ready-made smart butler is on standby the moment you enter, capable of reading through your previous butler's entire memo notebook.⟧

When switching from another coding assistant to Codex, you do not need to reteach your formatting style and preferred syntax from scratch; simply import your existing memory files, and the fresh profile will immediately work according to your established habits.

items.original: Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面在參數錯誤時保持可編輯，新工作階段沿用預設審核者
title.en: TUI Preferences Remain Editable on Invalid Settings, Fresh Sessions Honor Default Reviewer

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面操作工具時，如果遇到執行參數填寫錯誤，偏好設定選單一旦被連帶鎖死，往往會讓人動彈不得。

針對終端使用者介面（以純文字排版的終端機視窗），現在即便執行設定中存在無效參數，偏好設定依然保持可編輯狀態，且修改後能立即生效。新開啟的終端工作階段在未提供明確覆寫時，現在也會確實遵循伺服器的預設審核者規則。

⟦彷彿汽車儀表板的設定選單，以前只要感測器回報異常數值，整個操作面板就跟著卡死無法調整；現在各項控制選項依然能隨意修改並即時生效，新發動的車輛也會主動遵循車隊預設的安全指派。⟧

無論是不慎輸入了無效路徑，或是剛啟動全新的終端對話，介面都不會再無故罷工，各項審核權限也能正常運作。
body.en:
When operating tools in a terminal interface, if execution parameters are entered incorrectly and the preference menu freezes as a result, you are often left stuck.

For the terminal user interface (a text-based terminal display), preferences now remain editable and take effect immediately even when invalid parameters exist in execution settings. Fresh terminal sessions also properly honor the server's default approval reviewer rules when no explicit override is provided.

⟦The settings menu on a car dashboard mirrors this behavior. In the past, whenever a sensor reported an abnormal reading, the entire console froze and prevented adjustments. Now control options remain fully editable with immediate effect, and newly started vehicles actively follow default safety assignments set by the fleet.⟧

Whether you accidentally enter an invalid path or just launched a brand new terminal conversation, the interface will no longer freeze without cause, and approval permissions continue to function normally.

items.original:
Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)

title.zh-TW: 中斷與取消時即刻停止背景運算，模型找不到不再盲目重試
title.en: Promptly Stop Background Tasks on Interrupt and Cancellation, Stop Blind Retries for Missing Models

body.zh-TW:
當你在操作過程中按下停止或遇到無效請求時，背景程式如果持續空轉或重複嘗試，往往會白白消耗運算資源與等待時間。

⟦有如辦公大樓的撤銷派工機制，以前專案喊停後外包廠商依然繼續趕工，送錯地址的公文還在不斷重複投遞；現在只要前端發出取消通知，所有外派作業與無效配送都會立刻剎車。⟧

第一項改動針對遠端 MCP 工具（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）。如果本機端已經取消或不再等待回傳結果，會主動向遠端發送取消通知，避免遠端伺服器徒勞運算。

第二項調整落在代理訊息排隊機制。當你在對話中按鍵中斷執行，或是切換到計畫模式時，已排隊的訊息不會再擅自重啟工作。

第三項改動則是在模型提供者回報找不到指定型號時，工具會立即停止重複嘗試，並完整保留原本的錯誤訊息。

以前遇到操作中斷或設定失效時，背景可能會持續重試或再度喚醒任務，現在各項失效請求都能及時收手。
body.en:
When you press stop during an operation or encounter an invalid request, background processes that continue idling or repeatedly retrying waste computing resources and waiting time.

⟦An office building's dispatch cancellation mechanism works in much the same way. Previously, contractors continued rushing work after a project was halted, and misaddressed documents were repeatedly redelivered. Now, once the front desk issues a cancellation notice, all dispatched tasks and invalid deliveries brake immediately.⟧

The first change applies to remote MCP tools (protocols that connect AI to external tools). If the local side has cancelled or no longer waits for returned results, it actively sends a cancellation notice to the remote side, preventing remote servers from wasting compute.

The second adjustment targets the agent message queuing mechanism. When you press a key to interrupt execution during a conversation or switch to Plan mode, queued messages will no longer restart work without permission.

The third change stops retrying immediately when a model provider reports that a specified model was not found, fully preserving the original error message.

Previously, when operations were interrupted or settings failed, background processes might continuously retry or wake tasks back up; now invalid requests cease promptly.

items.original:
Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)

title.zh-TW: 市集網址驗證補強防護，防範 Git 連線至未經授權的主機
title.en: Marketplace URL Validation Strengthened to Prevent Git Connecting to Unauthorized Hosts

body.zh-TW:
從擴充市集下載外掛或套件時，工具能否嚴格把關下載來源，攸關整個開發環境的安全。

市集網址的驗證機制現在補上了防護漏洞。以往在比對網址時存在落差，可能導致 Git 最終連線的主機，與安全名單中所允許的主機並不一致。這個驗證漏洞已經補上，Git 不會再連到與允許名單所檢查的不同主機。

⟦猶如社區門禁核對訪客名單，以前警衛登記的地址和訪客實際去的地方可能對不上，現在這個對不上的漏洞已經補上。⟧

這個問題已經修好，安裝市集套件時不會再因網址歧異而誤連至未授權的外部主機。
body.en:
When downloading plugins or packages from an extension marketplace, whether a tool strictly verifies download sources is vital to the security of your entire development environment.

The marketplace URL validation mechanism has now closed a security gap. In the past, discrepancies during URL matching could cause Git to ultimately connect to a different host from the one permitted on the safe list. This validation gap has been closed, ensuring Git will no longer connect to a host different from the one checked against the allowlist.

⟦Checking visitor logs at a gated community entrance reflects this safeguard. Previously, the address recorded by a guard might not match where a visitor actually went; now this mismatch loophole has been firmly closed.⟧

This issue has been fixed, so installing marketplace packages will no longer inadvertently connect to unauthorized external hosts due to URL discrepancies.

items.original: Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)

title.zh-TW: 外掛設定支援選填金鑰，未設定也能以免費頻率發送請求
title.en: Plugin Settings Support Optional Keys, Allowing Requests at Free Limits When Unset

body.zh-TW:
當你安裝了串接網路服務的擴充外掛，只想先體驗基本功能，手邊暫時沒有現成的帳號。現在外掛的 `auth.json` 支援將 API 金鑰（向線上服務驗證身分的存取密碼）提供者標記為選填。⟦跟參觀公立展覽館一樣，以前入口處一律要求掏出會員證，沒帶證件就被擋在門外；現在沒登記的訪客也能直接領取普通號碼牌入場，出示專屬卡片則能兌換更多參觀配額。⟧

針對那些不需金鑰就能運作、但附上金鑰可以提高限流（服務限制單位時間內發送次數的機制）門檻的服務，只要在 `auth.json` 設定：

```json
{
  "optional": true
}
```

當你尚未設定金鑰時，外掛指令會把該變數視為未設定，並直接以免費額度上限發出未驗證請求。當你剛裝好外掛想先快速查詢公開資料，手邊還沒申請金鑰也能直接呼叫，不再跳出 `401` 錯誤或被強制中斷要求登入。
body.en:
When you install an extension plugin that connects to an online service and just want to try basic features first, you might not have an existing account on hand. A plugin's `auth.json` now supports marking API key (an access password that verifies identity with an online service) providers as optional. ⟦Much like visiting a public exhibition hall, the entrance previously always required pulling out a membership card and turned away anyone without credentials; now, unregistered visitors can directly pick up a regular number tag to enter, while presenting a dedicated card grants a larger visiting quota.⟧

For services that work without a key but raise rate limits (a mechanism restricting how many requests can be sent per unit of time) with one, simply configure `auth.json`:

```json
{
  "optional": true
}
```

When you have not set the key, the plugin's commands now see the variable as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit. When you have just installed a plugin and want to quickly look up public data before applying for a key, you can make calls directly without encountering `401` errors or being interrupted to sign in.

items.original: Added `"optional": true` for API key providers in a plugin's `auth.json`, for services that work without a key but raise rate limits with one: when you haven't set the key, the plugin's commands now see the variable as unset and make unauthenticated requests at the free rate limit, instead of failing with `401` errors or asking you to sign in.

title.zh-TW: 串流長表格待完成才推入捲動歷程，邊框不再歪斜或重複文字
title.en: Streaming Long Tables Reach Scrollback Only After Completion, Eliminating Misaligned Borders and Repeated Text

body.zh-TW: 在終端機接收長篇回覆時，如果內容包含 Markdown 表格，往上翻閱常會看見版面混亂。以前在串流（模型一邊生成一邊即時顯示的方式）輸出時，表格列會過早滾入終端機歷史紀錄，留下歪斜的邊框與重複文字。現在表格各列在完成前會停留在即時畫面，待整張表格完成後才以最終欄寬推入捲動紀錄，以前向上翻閱會撞見的錯位問題已不會再發生。
body.en: When receiving long replies in the terminal, scrolling up often revealed broken layouts if the content included Markdown tables. Previously during streaming (displaying output in real time as the model generates it) output, table rows rolled into terminal scrollback too early, leaving misaligned borders and repeated text. Now, a table's rows stay in the live view until the table is complete, reaching scrollback with their final column widths so that the misalignment previously encountered when scrolling up no longer occurs.

items.original: Fixed Markdown tables in long streaming replies leaving misaligned borders and repeated text in your terminal scrollback: a table's rows now stay in the live view until the table is complete, so they reach scrollback with their final column widths.
